title: Night Surge Handoff Cheatlist
content:
Quick context: I'm on the late rota tonight. This is a small, messy cheatlist intended for whoever picks up the shift — TL;DR steps, temporary mitigations, and things to follow up in the morning. 

CURRENT STATE (snapshot at 22:15 PT):
- No P0s open.
- Elevated 5xx rate on hosted-api route /v1/generate-us-west (spike started ~21:40).
- A single Dedicated pool node (dedicated-pool-east-3) returned intermittent OOMs earlier but auto-healed; monitoring shows higher latency on requests authed with customer-tenant: acme-inc.
- KV cache hit rate dipped from 78% -> 52% after midnight traffic shift (suspect different prompt prefix distribution).

IMMEDIATE TRIAGE CHECKLIST (first 10 minutes):
1) Check Redwood Console -> Routes -> /v1/generate-us-west: look at per-token latency and error traces. Note the top error types.
2) Slack: post short status to #oncall and #redwood-status with current 5xx rate and whether we're throttling.
3) Run quick health checks: 
   - curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ONCALL_API_KEY}" https://api.redwood.ai/health || echo "health endpoint failed"
   - kubectl get pods -n dedicated-pool-east-3 -o wide  (if you don't have k8s access, use the console node view)
4) If errors are model-serving OOMs, try temporary fallback: route to quantized-variant (model-version: v2-q4_0) for the affected route via rollout -> canary 5% -> monitor 5 mins.

QUICK MITIGATIONS (order by low-risk):
- Reduce batch size for the affected route: set max_batch_tokens to 512 for /v1/generate-us-west via Console -> Config overrides. This reduces throughput but lowers OOM risk.
- Enable cache-only for non-critical completion paths: set prefer_cached_responses = true on the route (short-term).
- Apply rate limit to acme-inc tenant: throttle to 80rps (tenant-level) if a single customer shows disproportionate retries.

COMMANDS SNIPPET (copy-paste):
- Check route errors: rcli routes tail-errors --route /v1/generate-us-west --since 30m
- Force rollout to quantized variant (dry): rcli deploy plan --route /v1/generate-us-west --model redwood/llama-like:v2-q4_0 --percent 5
- Increase autoscaler cool-down: rcli autoscale update --pool dedicated-pool-east-3 --scale-down-delay 600s

ESCALATION PATH (if P0):
1) Pager to SRE lead (Marco Alvarez) — call if degradation persists >15m after mitigations.
2) Paging to Eng-serving-runtime (on-call rotation) for kernel-level failures.
3) Exec + CCO if customer SLA breach imminent (notify product + CSM).

KNOWN WORKAROUNDS (notes to self):
- If KV cache hit rate stays low after 30m: a quick cold-start can be mitigated by warming the cache with a synthetic prefix set: run `scripts/cache-warmup/warm_prefixes.sh --region us-west1 --route /v1/generate-us-west` (requires infra creds).
- If latency increases only for long-context requests (>2048 tokens), suggest fallback to shorter context model variant and add a customer-facing note later.

MORNING FOLLOW-UP ITEMS (assign):
- Investigate root cause for KV cache distribution change (possible prompt template rollout in acme-inc). Link: JIRA-RW-2381 (assign to Priya).
- Add automated alert for >30% drop in KV hit rate across routes (SRE backlog).
- Confirm whether the dedicated-pool OOMs correlated with a particular model version (check recent rollouts).

THINGS I DID / DECISIONS MADE WHILE ONCALL: (for handoff)
- Lowered max_batch_tokens to 512 for /v1/generate-us-west at 21:55 PT (temporary).
- Initiated a 5% canary to v2-q4_0 at 22:05 PT (observing for 15m).
- Posted brief incident note to #oncall at 22:12 PT.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODOS (keep concise):
- Did acme-inc roll out a new prompt set this evening? (Ping product-eng via Slack thread #acme-integration).
- Is the autoscaler still scaling correctly for dedicated-pool-east-3? (Check cloud metrics for GPU queue length).

CHEATS / COMMON LINKS: (put these in your slack pinned message)
- Console route page: https://console.redwood.ai/routes/v1-generate-us-west
- Incident playbook (quick): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONCALL/quickplay
- Infra PR that changed autoscaler: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512

LOCAL NOTES (privacy: personal shorthand):
- If you see "cuda out of memory" + kernel restarts -> prefer smaller model variant, then start cache warmup.
- Don't escalate to product unless customer-visible errors persist >20m after rollbacks.

FINAL: leave a 1-line summary for morning: e.g. "Mitigations active: batch size reduced, 5% quantized canary running; monitor KV hit rate & acme tenant traffic."

— Sofia

(If you're reading this and taking over: sorry for the messy scraps. Add to this doc if you changed anything so morning team isn't surprised.)
